title: How to Spot a One-Way Street Instantly: All Parked Cars Face Same Way, All White Lane Lines & Backs of Signs Facing One Direction

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All vehicles in travel lanes and parked on both curbs face forward away from camera; no opposing faces in same lane.

single_bulb_signal.note: Two small distant signals on poles appear dark with no multiple lit lenses visible.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: One-way flow away from camera with yellow line on far left edge and white line on right edge, all-white dashed dividers, consistent with US one-way.

zero_text.note: All billboards, store signs, pole signs, and license plates are blank geometric shapes with no letters or numbers.

scene_match.note: Shows 3-lane one-way street with all white dashed dividers and all parked cars on left and right facing same forward direction as traffic.

result.summary: Elevated one-way street correctly shows same-direction traffic and parking with white dividers and blank signage, meeting all rules.

teaching_correct.note: Correctly teaches one-way clues: same-direction parked cars, all-white lane lines, one-direction flow with proper edge colors.
